Traffic Advisory for Saturday, March 28, 2026.

Multiple events will be taking place around Greensboro on Saturday, and two of the events will span multiple streets and roadways.

The 'Only Fools' marathon and the No Kings Protest will take place starting around 7:30 a.m. and will last until around 1 p.m. (Individual times for each can be seen on the graphics provided.)

Thank you for your understanding during your weekend commute!
